summary: Completed a massive UX/UI sprint resulting in the Alt1 design system upgrades, brand logo updates, a unified Home/Search gateway, and advanced numerical score filters correctly hooked up to Typesense and Supabase RPCs.
decisions: Merged home and search pages via a central hero search bar.
Renamed Semantic search to Concept search for users on the frontend.
Implemented minimum score numeric sliders acting directly on the API route to override default filter arrays.
Redesigned the Admin Intake page to the light slate theme for consistency with other admin UI.
